messages:
ana: Heads-up: new int4 bring-up (pegasus-mini-q) is showing ~1.7% funcall schema failures on mirror traffic. Failures are almost all truncated JSON suffixes for requests with long optional 'events' arrays.

ben: Is this streaming-only or also non-streaming?

ana: Mostly streaming. Non-streaming is clean. The truncation looks like a mid-byte cut, so final UTF-8 char is broken and the JSON ends without a closing bracket/brace. Example (redacted):
```
..., "events": ["e1", "e2", "e3", "e4", "e5"
```
(no closing ])

claire: Interesting. Could be packer/kv-cache margin + quant detokenize edge. Any seq_len correlation?

ana: Spike when token_count > 440 and when we batch-pack multiple small requests.

dmitri: Quick proposal: three-pronged approach: (1) conservative responder that validates UTF-8 + JSON termination before returning streaming final chunk, (2) schema-path repair whitelist for optional arrays only (emit telemetry), (3) runtime toggle pad_final_token=true that forces a reserved safe token at end so detokenizer never truncates mid-byte.

ben: For repair whitelist: I want a simple config like repairable_paths=["/events", "/meta/notes"] so we don't invent required fields.

claire: Also add a soft-fail response code for callers: 424/struct-truncated with a short hint and a repair_token so SDKs can auto-retry with full context. Safer than silent repair.

heal-bot: alert created: canary-parse-rate > 0.5% for 2m.

dmitri: Telemetry we need: parse_failures_total, parse_failures_by_path, repair_attempted, repair_success_rate, average_latency_post_repair, token_window_at_boundary (for kernel debug).

ana: I'll pause the public rollout and switch mirror traffic to baseline float variant for now. Running a focused 150k mirror A/B with pad_final_token + whitelist repair enabled.

ben: Add a unit/regression test that simulates a last-byte truncation at detokenize time and asserts that repair never adds required keys. Fail build if it does.

claire: I'll add canary rule: if residual parse_failures > 0.3% for 10m, auto-roll back to float baseline.

ana: Action list:
- ana: pause rollout, run 150k A/B (ETA EOD)
- dmitri: implement pad_final_token toggle + repair whitelist (ETA 3h)
- ben: add unit test + SDK hint handling (ETA 4h)
- claire: alarms + telemetry dashboards (ETA 2h)

dmitri: dropping a redacted trace for kernel team: /infra/traces/pegasus-mini-q/trace-3333337777.log

ana: Thanks all. Will post A/B results in this thread. :thumbsup:
